steps.title: Prepare Input Files
steps.instruction: Create the necessary mapping files for the analysis pipeline.

substeps.instruction: Prepare a plate map .xlsx file (starting density plate A) with one plate per sheet, where cells contain the strain-id.
Prepare a .xlsx file specifying the strain-id to orf-name relationship, with strain_id in the first column and orf_name in the second column.

steps.title: Install Dependencies and Software
steps.instruction: Set up the required MATLAB tools and LID scripts.

substeps.instruction: Install Database Toolbox via APPS > Get More Apps in MATLAB.
Download and unzip the mysql connector JDBC driver.
Clone the following repositories into the MATLAB folder: Matlab-Colony-Analyzer-Toolkit.git, bean-matlab-toolkit.git, lidetector.git, and sau-matlab-toolkit.git.

steps.title: Configure Bash Scripts
steps.instruction: Make the LID bash scripts executable within the lidetector directory.

steps.title: Initialize Database
steps.instruction: Execute the initialize.sh script from the lidetector folder using the required experimental metadata.

substeps.instruction: Ensure you have the following information ready: MySQL credentials (username, password, database name), experiment name (prefix for tables), upscale patterns (combinations of lower density plates condensed to higher density plates), reference strain orf_name, and file paths to the plate map and strain-id/orf-name .xlsx files.

steps.title: Organize Colony Size Estimations
steps.instruction: Prepare colony size estimation data using a tool such as the MATLAB Colony Analyzer Toolkit (MCAT).

substeps.instruction: Organize data in ascending order of hours, plate number, column number, and row number.
Ensure the file structure includes pixel counts from multiple images (e.g., image1, image2, image3) and an average column consisting of the average pixel count of those images.

steps.title: Generate Raw Data Tables
steps.instruction: Combine the colony size estimation table with position IDs from the _pos2coor table.

substeps.instruction: Verify the generation of _RAW (raw estimations per hour per position id), _smudgebox (excluded position ids), and _JPEG (cleaned table where border colonies, smudge box colonies, and colonies with pixel count < 10 are NULL'd).

steps.title: Execute LI Detector
steps.instruction: Run the main LI Detector script to calculate fitness measurements.

substeps.instruction: Ensure you have the paths to the MATLAB directory, lidetector directory, and the unzipped JDBC driver.

Run './lid.sh' to generate the following tables: _NORM (relative fitness and background pixel count), _FITNESS (relative fitness with strain ids and orf-names), _FITNESS_STAT (mean, median, and standard deviation of relative fitness), and _PVALUE (empirical p-values).
